meta_description: AK Electrical Installations Ltd in Birmingham. Full rewires, testing, installations & emergency repairs. Part P certified. Call 07761 678677.
hero_eyebrow: Part P Certified — Fast, Reliable Installations
hero_subhead: From full rewires to emergency fault repairs, we deliver safe, compliant installations across Birmingham and the West Midlands.
services_subhead: Whether you need a complete rewire, a new circuit installed, or an emergency repair, we've got the expertise and speed you need.

services.title: Complete House Rewires
services.desc: Full rewires for older properties or major upgrades. We manage the paperwork, minimise disruption, and leave you with a modern, safe system backed by our 10-year workmanship guarantee.

services.title: New Kitchen & Bathroom Wiring
services.desc: Dedicated circuits for kitchens and bathrooms, to Building Regs standards. Includes sockets, lighting, and extraction fan wiring tailored to your layout.

services.title: Emergency Fault Repairs
services.desc: Blown fuses, dead sockets, flickering lights? We diagnose and fix faults fast — most jobs completed same day, with full diagnostics included.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades & RCD Protection
services.desc: Modern circuit breakers and RCD protection for peace of mind. We install upgrades to current standards and handle all certification.

services.title: Testing & Inspection (EICR)
services.desc: Annual safety checks and electrical condition reports for landlords, businesses, and homeowners. Full documentation provided.

services.title: Solar Panel & EV Charger Installation
services.desc: Expert installation of solar arrays and home EV chargers, with grid connection management and all necessary permissions arranged.

about_pullquote: We do the job right first time — no shortcuts, no surprises on the bill.
about_para_1: AK Electrical Installations was founded on a simple idea: provide Birmingham with electricians you can trust to show up on time, do excellent work, and explain what's happening every step of the way. Over 15 years we've built our reputation by treating every job — whether a single socket or a full rewire — with the same attention to detail and professionalism.
about_para_2: We're Part P certified and keep pace with the latest Building Regulations, so you know your installation is compliant and safe. Our customers come back to us because we answer the phone, arrive when we promise, and leave your home clean and tidy. That's not fancy — it's just the standard we set ourselves.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a complete kitchen rewire done last month. Mark and the team were brilliant — turned up dead on time, explained everything, and cleared up after themselves. The price was fair and we got it all done in two days. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: Our electrics went haywire on a Sunday evening. Called AK and they had someone out within 90 minutes to track down a faulty circuit. Diagnosed and fixed it all without unnecessary work. Professional blokes and honest pricing. Very impressed.
reviews.author: Emma T.

reviews.text: Needed an EV charger installing at home. From the first call to completion, the service was seamless. They sorted the supply upgrade, all the paperwork, and the installation was clean and quick. Would definitely recommend to anyone in the Midlands.
reviews.author: James W.
